notes:
Hoshi 0.3.0 is available. Hoshi 0.3.0 adds automatic descriptions and artwork from folder/file names, with built-in metadata providers and a review interface.

- **Anime and shows:** Kitsu and TVmaze work without an API key. **Movies:** optional TMDB uses your own server-only API Read Access Token.
- Series and episode descriptions, titles, posters, backdrops, episode thumbnails, genres, ratings, air dates, episode counts and provider credits.
- Local NFO support; manual edits take priority and survive refreshes, including deliberately blank fields.
- Candidate search, uncertain-match review, identity locking, group identification, per-library refresh progress and an offline switch.
- Persistent metadata/artwork caches, request timeouts, rate spacing and backoff, safe CDN downloads, no arbitrary NFO URL fetching, and preservation of saved metadata during outages.
- Faster incremental rescans and retained catalog availability beneath temporarily unreadable subfolders. Same-title remakes remain separate.
- Retains multilingual audio/subtitles, real timeline previews, intro detection/review/skip, personal anime watchlists, and release notifications.

Validated with automated matching, NFO, provider, cache, permissions, migration and concurrency tests; live Kitsu/TVmaze requests; Chrome desktop/mobile metadata workflows and playback regression; native release builds on Windows x64, Linux x64/ARM64 and macOS ARM64. Linux also runs real FFmpeg checks and an x64 Docker smoke test. TMDB integration is fixture-tested; Hoshi does not ship with a TMDB account token.

**Install:** download your platform archive and matching SHA-256 file, verify the checksum, extract, and follow README.md. FFmpeg and FFprobe are installed separately for advanced playback. Ubuntu Server requires no desktop.

**Upgrade:** stop Hoshi, back up its full data directory, replace the executable, then restart with the same data directory. Existing accounts, libraries, progress, watchlists and manual edits are retained. Existing libraries start background metadata lookup. Set `HOSHI_METADATA_ENABLED=0` before startup to remain offline.

Read [the metadata guide](https://github.com/YTStatikGaming/hoshi-updates/blob/main/docs/METADATA.md). Hoshi remains an alpha; hardware transcoding, adaptive streaming, TV/mobile clients, Jellyfin plugin compatibility, and full Jellyfin parity are not included. Intro fingerprint suggestions
